description: The units at a CEP (apartment, store), with the complement and the type, in pages. The CEP lookup groups the addresses by street and number; this tool returns each unit. Without `logradouro` and `numero`, it pages through the whole CEP.

cep.description: 8 digits, with or without the hyphen.

logradouro.description: The street exactly as in the lookup (type and name).

numero.description: The building number in the result.

name: unidades
title: Units at a CEP
